capabilities: generate collapsible mind maps from Markdown, DOCX and PDF headings
explore and edit document sections beside the map in Radial, Horizontal or Compact layouts
draft new notes from branches, an Inbox and a free canvas, then create a Markdown file
export the visible map as SVG or PNG
customize colors, surfaces, typography and interface language
extras: Composer drafts are stored in plugin data.json, not as Markdown; the README tells users to back up before uninstalling. DOCX writes create a .cmm-backup- copy first. Import limits apply (DOCX 32 MiB, PDF 1000 pages). Not validated on mobile; coexistence tested on desktop only.
intentEvidence: Generate a collapsible map from a Markdown, DOCX, PDF or heading-based text card
problem: Obsidian Canvas has no mind-map layouts, collapsible heading-based branches, or outline-driven writing, so mapping a document means placing nodes by hand.

relations.evidence: Early development migrated a limited set of Canvas interface integration implementations from Enhanced Canvas.

summary: Mind-mapping workspace that turns Markdown, DOCX and PDF documents into collapsible mind maps, with explore, compose and native-Canvas modes.
